## [1.0.0](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

Apple Music 7.0.0 on the BYD DiLink 3.0 (Android 10): landscape/tablet UI, minSdk 29, API 30 backport (WindowInsetsControllerCompat, Objects.requireNonNullElse, List.of) and Play Integrity bypass. Runtime on the head unit is not tested yet.
